shots.visual: 林昭抬脚踏上第一级白玉阶，脚下云海轰然炸开，衣袍被罡风猛地掀起。
shots.prompt_en: Lin Zhao, stepping onto first white jade stair, robes violently billowing in fierce wind, exploding sea of clouds beneath feet, swirling mist, dramatic backlight, cold ethereal glow

shots.visual: 云海之上白玉天梯直插天穹，看不到尽头，金霞铺满台阶，风把云吹成河流。
shots.prompt_en: white jade heavenly staircase above sea of clouds, reaching into sky, endless, golden sunset glow covering steps, wind blowing clouds into flowing river, vast sky, ethereal lighting

shots.visual: 他一步步踏阶而上，玉阶被踩出裂纹，身后宗门缩成一个黑点，脚下云层翻涌。
shots.prompt_en: young man ascending jade stairs, foot cracking stone steps, sect shrinking to black dot behind, churning sea of clouds below, swirling mist, cold dim light, wide shot

shots.visual: 天梯尽头的骸骨长廊，数十具白骨靠壁而坐，每具胸口都嵌着一段断裂的锁链。
shots.action: 穿行长廊、锁链残片轻晃
shots.dialogue: 林昭：第九个……我是第九个？
shots.prompt_en: skeletal corridor at heavenly stair summit, dozens of skeletons sitting against walls, broken chains embedded in each chest, bone-lined passage, dim eerie glow, cold blue light, deep shadows

shots.visual: 一具白骨的手骨攥着一块残碑，碑上刻着「第九个」三字，指骨已经嵌进石缝。
shots.prompt_en: skeletal hand gripping broken stone tablet, carved chinese characters, finger bones embedded in stone cracks, ancient ruins, dim eerie light, close-up

shots.visual: 老墨在长廊尽头解下蒙眼的旧布，睁开眼，瞳孔是与林昭相同的雷纹，金光在纹路里流动。
shots.prompt_en: old man untying blindfold at end of long corridor, opening eyes, lightning-pattern pupils, flowing golden light in eye veins, dark hall, dramatic glow
